Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 22
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer prematurely declared the result and directed output of a final percentage, falsely stating the script had successfully calculated it, despite no execution and no verified counts. This led to the final 38% figure being based on placeholder/simulated values rather than a real comparison of 1959 dehydrated/frozen items against 2023 supersessions.
